World/Dialogs/c5/Mythic_Aeon/TerendelevC._resolvedText: "What do you think of Drezen?"
"How does it feel to leave Kenabres?"
"How did you become Kenabres's champion?"
"Tell me about yourself."
"Tell me more about dragons."
"I have to go."
"I did not expect to see you here."
"What other kinds of dragons are there?"
"What makes silver dragons different from other dragons?"
"Can all dragons turn into humans like you do?"
"Thank you. You've told me everything I wanted to know."
"I wish to speak about something else."
{n}Terendelev greets you with a warm smile.{/n} "Commander. We meet again... in a city that is at peace. I hope we can make it a tradition."
"Of course. What would you like to know?"
"I hope we meet again."

"I spent many long years fighting for Iomedae, because I couldn't bear to see the innocent suffer and die. I've witnessed many woes, and the demonic corruption almost broke my spirit. However, the gold dragon Halaseliax, my mentor, managed to bring me back to the light. I swore an oath to defend the Wardstone so that the demons would never harm anyone again."

"I feel worried! I haven't left Kenabres in such a long time... This must be what a young mother feels like when she flies off hunting for the first time after her children have hatched." {n}Terendelev smiles.{/n} "But the townspeople of Kenabres are not helpless children. If disaster strikes, they will hold out long enough for my return."
"What do you wish to know?"

{n}Terendelev smiles.{/n} "I spent a long time debating whether or not to leave Kenabres, but in the end I decided to come. How could I miss an event like this? You saved me on the day of my defeat, so I want to congratulate you on the day of your triumph."

"Drezen... No longer looks like a Golarion fortress. I feel like I am in an {g|Axis}Axis{/g} city. Axiomites and inevitables may frighten some, but the sight of them fills my soul with peace. They are creatures of balance, and therefore, they bring balance wherever they go."
"I'm glad that I could share my knowledge with you."

"Oh, multitudes! There are metallic dragons, like myself, and planar dragons, who dwell in other worlds. There are the imperial dragons of Tian Xia, the keepers of balance... and of course, there are chromatic dragons, but you're probably familiar with them already... It would take a while to name all the different kinds of dragons. Just like the mortals of Golarion, we all have very different habits and personalities, but we also share a lot of common traits."

{n}Terendelev smiles.{/n} "I am tempted to say that we are the noblest of all dragons, but that would make me sound conceited. Some call us the bravest of the dragons, but I make no such claim myself. All I can say is that we seek to help others, and that we take great interest in the affairs of the world."

"No, they cannot. Not all dragons wish to learn this ability. I choose to look like a human because I am used to this form. Kenabres is too small and cramped for a dragon. I'm afraid I would step in the wrong place, and crush your cute little houses!" {n}Terendelev laughs.{/n} "My kin live in the mountains, where the caves are spacious. They seldom descend to human settlements, so many of them do not feel the need to take on other forms."
"As you wish."

"At first, I only thought of Kenabres as the location of the Wardstone. But eventually I fell in love with the city... its courageous townsfolk, and its beautiful old streets. And the city, in turn, fell in love with me. You could say that we became a family."

"We are ancient beings. We live for millenia, mostly away from humans. To us, the lives of warm-blooded creatures are fleeting and hardly last longer than a moment." {n}Terendelev sighs.{/n} "We've always been reclusive, but the opening of the Worldwound stirred many into action. The world had changed, and we had to change, too. I chose to be a champion of the meek, and I have never regretted my decision."

"We honor our oaths, and respect the rules. We follow a code of honor. The older a silver dragon becomes, the more it adheres to these customs and rituals. Even our brethren, the other metallic dragons, often fail to understand our way of life. Many believe that the rules we follow are outdated and obsolete. But our elders live such pure, beautiful lives... It is a shame that the other dragons do not see the value of such a lifestyle. I am still young and inexperienced, but I hope that by the time I am a thousand years old, I too have learned to live such an exemplary life."

"I am an aeon, I know the past and the future. Please, heed my words and accept my aid in the upcoming battle against Deskari."
"I am the Commander of the Crusade! The Queen trusts me, and so should you!"
"Listen to me, you dumb lizard. If you want to live, you need to do what I say. I am the Commander of the Fifth Crusade, and this is a serious matter!"
{n}Terendelev turns to you with obvious confusion.{/n} "I greet you again, brave Crusader. Do you prefer my company over the entertainments that have been provided?"

{n}Terendelev looks at you sympathetically.{/n} "Painful wounds and the horrors of war can often beget nightmares. But do not fear. You are safe. The demons can't reach you here. Even Deskari is not all-powerful."
{n}Terendelev gazes at you pensively.{/n} "You look like you have aged — as if it has been years since we last met, not minutes."
{n}Terendelev studies you for a while.{/n} "You have the eyes of a creature older than time itself. Your breath is as cold as the starlit deserts that lie beyond this world."

{n}Terendelev looks you in the eye.{/n} "An aeon... Yes, crusader, I feel the currents of energy that swirl around you. Your breath is as cold as the starlit deserts that lie in the great beyond. But that does not make you an aeon. I sense your lack of balance. You are not ready to cast away the things of this world in order to preserve equilibrium."

{n}Terendelev shakes her head.{/n} "Queen Galfrey commands the crusade. She does travel incognito among her subjects sometimes, but even in disguise, she would not appear as you do now. Your appearances are too dissimilar. I do not appreciate this jest. Farewell, and do not trouble me again."

"I do not know why you are trying to distract me with this nonsense. I do not know whether or not you truly believe what you are saying... But I refuse to believe you. You are no aeon. Farewell, and do not trouble me again."

You wish to undo this event because it conflicts with the world order." {n}Terendelev looks away and shakes her head.{/n} "Even I cannot look you in the eye for long. But whatever your reasons for helping me — I am grateful. Together, we will endure the coming storm. I am sure of it."

{n}You know Terendelev will understand your message. She will see that your mortal shape, much like her own, are only conventions. You will show her what you see in the mirror. She will look into the eyes of the aeon, and see the universe.{/n}

{n}Terendelev just smiles.{/n} "Your angry outburst reminds me of a small child throwing a tantrum to get their mother's attention. But you should not be angry. I gave you my attention. I heard what you had to say. Now I must bid you farewell. Please do not trouble me again."

{n}The currents of time are swift, and resist your attempts to divert them to a different course. Time flows past you like a mountain stream. Everything will happen as it did before. Nothing will be changed. The past purges you like poison.{/n}
"You're alive... and that means I managed to change the past."
"What happened to Kenabres after I saved you?"
"How did you manage to survive the fight with Deskari?"
"The balance of the Universe is restored. There is nothing left for me to do here."
"What will you do now?"
{n}Terendelev bows low.{/n} "Commander. The day has finally come when I can thank you properly. I was told that you were in Kenabres, so I hurried to the square." {n}She examines you closely.{/n}

{n}Terendelev looks at you sadly.{/n} "I remember the conversation we had before the battle. In your timeline, I was too weak and unprepared... I did not survive. The only reason I am alive today is because you saved me. But I've learned my lesson. Now, I am always prepared for a fight. I never let down my guard!"

"After you disappeared, I continued to defend the city, even though Deskari had wounded me severely. Fortunately, he could not summon the bulk of his troops from the Abyss. The Wardstone bought us the time we needed to survive. Once Deskari realized he couldn't defeat us, he vanished, but his demons still poured into Kenabres. It was a bloody battle, but the crusaders managed to repel the invasion."

"Even though I knew the attack was going to happen, I did not expect the onslaught to be so fierce. I would never have survived without you. After you disappeared, I kept fighting until reinforcements arrived." {n}Terendelev lowers her eyes.{/n} "I felt the chill of death, and I nearly faltered before the foe. But your determination gave me the strength to keep fighting."
"Commander, my gratitude is not just empty words. I will send you a band of Kenabres's finest soldiers. Now that I have recovered from my wounds, I can once again defend the city."

"Now that I have recovered from my wound, I will continue to defend the city. This is my duty. Kenabres is vulnerable without the Wardstone. The city needs its champion. Thanks to you, I am prepared for the battles ahead."

"Sometimes, I think about what would have happened if Deskari had defeated me, and claimed the Wardstone. I imagine Kenabres lying in ruins... But thanks to you, we managed to avoid this fate. I do not have the words to express my gratitude. I owe you my life, and so do many others."

"The crusaders have done their best to rebuild Kenabres. The effort is still ongoing, but the progress is slow — many of them left for Drezen, and that's where we moved the Wardstone. Unfortunately, I couldn't help with the rebuilding process. My wounds left me so weak, I could barely move. I've been resting in my lair, and regaining my strength. But when they told me you were here, I had to come see you."
"Wait. After the battle against Deskari, a strange stone blade was found in the Market Square. The magic surrounding it is not familiar to me, but I feel that it is important. Please accept it."

"They keep their distance from me. Gone are the days when I would take walks in the square, and see smiles everywhere. Now, even those who knew me before avert their eyes. "Go to Drezen, and protect my ziggurat."
"You are now free. You may now fly wherever you wish."

{n}The magic that once filled the bones of the silver dragon with unlife has been dispelled. But you feel that Terendelev's soul has not yet departed to face Pharasma's judgment — and that means you can bind it with your spells, and enslave the corrupted creature.{/n}

"My soul withered and turned to evil, just like everything else touched by mortals. What irony! RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereItemFlav.Text: A single silvery scale from Terendelev's body modified by Storyteller. It is warm to the touch and seems to glow softly from within.
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereItemDesc.Text: Examine the scale to reach out to the being connected to the scale.
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereChpt01Dial001Ans0001.Text: [Flirt] "Perhaps you could show me around the festivities? I would love to get to know you better."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereChpt01Dial001Ans1001.Text: "Perhaps you could show me around the festivities? I would love to get to know you better."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereChpt01Dial001Cue0001.Text: {n}Terendelev responds with a light chuckle.{/n} "It has certainly been a long time since I was invited on a date. I've been told that I can be rather...intimidating in my draconic form. Alas, I must decline your invitation today because I am on duty to protect the festivities. Be sure to enjoy them on my behalf as well."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook00Page002Cue0001.Text: {n}And then you open your eyes. Storyteller stands before you still setting the scale down in your hand. The days of endless darkness seem to have happened in the blink of an eye. Storyteller raises an eyebrow as he looks at you.{/n} "You seem confused, did something happen? Perhaps you saw an endless darkness? I believe this is connected to Terendelev as I have seen similar, but much briefer, visions while viewing her story, but I'm afraid I can't tell you what these visions mean." {n}He picks up the scale and examines it once more.{/n}
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook00Page002Cue0002.Text: {n}Storyteller strokes his beard while he thinks.{/n} "Hmm, I believe this is connected to Terendelev as I have seen similar, but much briefer, visions while viewing her story, but I'm afraid I can't tell you what these visions mean." {n}He picks up the scale and examines it once more.{/n}
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook00Page002Cue0003.Text: "I believe I can alter the magic of this scale to make the connection to that voice more stable, but you will need more power to pierce that veil of darkness. However, you will no longer be able to use its healing magic. Would you like me to do that?"
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook00Page002Cue0004.Text: "I believe I can alter the magic of this scale to make the connection to that voice more stable. If you pour some of your mythic power into the scale, you might be able to pierce the darkness. However, you will no longer be able to use its healing magic. Would you like me to do that?"
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook00EndCue0001.Text: {n}Storyteller moves his finger along the surface of the scale tracing magic runes, soon the traced patterns glow as the magic of the scale is reconfigured. He returns the scale to you once more.{/n}
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook00EndCue0002.Text: "When you find a powerful magic, channel it into the scale to try and reach beyond that darkness."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook00EndCue0003.Text: "Focus on the scale when you wish to try and pierce the darkness."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook00EndCue0004.Text: "Very well, let me know if you change your mind, but be aware that you will need a massive power to pierce that darkness even with a more stable connection."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook01Page001Cue0001.Text:
{n}You focus your mythic power into the scale. Almost as soon as you begin channeling the energy, you find yourself robbed of your senses again. The endless darkness surrounds you once more. You attempt to begin your search for the voice, but it is impossible to tell if you are even moving without any senses.{/n}
{n}As you ponder how to proceed, an idea occurs to you. If mythic power brought you here, perhaps it can help you as well. And so you bring your power to bear. The illumination of your power pushes back the darkness and restores some semblance of your senses. As you attempt to gain your bearings, you hear a sniffle before a voice calls out seemingly from every direction.{/n} "Is that light? Is someone there?"
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook01Page001Ans0002.Text: "I am {name}, the Commander of the Fifth Crusade."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook01Page001Cue0002.Text: "The Fifth Crusade? That doesn't sound right. Were there that many? Why can't I remember?"
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook01Page001Cue0003.Text: "I'm... I don't. I don't know? Why do I not know who I am?"
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook01Page001Cue0004.Text: "Please tell me how you got here. The only thing I can remember clearly is this endless darkness. I was beginning to think that I was just a figment of the darkness's imagination. If something exists besides this emptiness, then I wish to escape."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook01Page001Ans0005.Text: "I reached this place using a scale of the silver dragon Terendelev."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook01Page001Cue0006.Text: "I can swear an oath that I mean you no harm right now, but that is all I can truthfully swear as I don't know who or what I am."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook01Page001Ans0007.Text: "I will not risk releasing an unknown evil."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook01Page002Cue0001.Text:
{n}You hear the voice vocalizing its frustrations as it seems to be thinking.{/n} "Terendelev? Why does that sound so familiar?" {n}Silence fills the darkness once more.{/n}
{n}As the silence drags on, you begin to wonder whether the voice had somehow left the void. Suddenly you are startled by a sudden exclamation.{/n} "I remember! I'm Terendelev!"
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook01Page002Ans0002.Text: "Do you remember how you got here or where here is?"
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook01Page002Cue0002.Text: "No. I might remember my name, but my memory is otherwise full of holes."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook01Page002Ans0003.Text: "Do you remember what happened to you?"
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook01Page002Cue0003.Text: "I was fighting Deskari. And then..." {n}"Terendelev" trails off as she seems to be remembering the fight.{/n} "I don't remember how it ended, but this isn't the River of the Souls or the Boneyard, so I guess it didn't end the way I would expect."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook01Page002Cue0004.Text: "I'm sorry. All I can see of you right now is a blinding light, so I can't tell if I've ever seen you before. If I knew your name before, I'm afraid that my memory of that is missing."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook01EndCue0001.Text:
{n}The voice remains silent for a few moments.{/n} "I can't fault you for that choice. I wish you safety in your return to a world that I assume has more than darkness."
{n}You blink as you find yourself back in reality. You look down to find that the scale has darkened and shattered. You briefly try and focus on the remnants before determining that the scale no longer works.{/n}
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook02Page001Cue0001.Text:
{n}You focus your mythic power into the scale once again. Something is different this time. Your senses don't immediately abandon you. Instead, you find yourself in an empty field at night with a cloudless sky. The stars shine brightly above you. As you begin to look around, you hear a voice cry out from behind you.{/n} 
"There you are! I had a feeling you were here. I don't really know why, but I could just feel your arrival." {n}As you turn around, you see Terendelev's human form standing behind you. She looks nearly identical to how you recall last seeing here.{/n}
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook02Page001Cue0002.Text: "I... don't know. I was hoping you might know. The last time you visited, I tried to follow you. I knew that it wouldn't work, but somehow, I managed to escape the darkness and ended up here. Since you don't know this place, I guess you didn't travel through here when you were projecting into the darkness."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook02Page001Cue0003.Text: "Better? I'm not lost in the darkness anymore, but I don't know where we are now. I wish I could return to civilization, but I can find no settlements anywhere I wander and no transportation magic seems to work."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook02Page001Cue0004.Text: {n}Terendelev shuffles her feet a little while looking down.{/n} "I can't seem to transform into my true form. I don't know if there is something suppressing the magic I use to switch between my forms or if the darkness did something to me. It is honestly rather concerning, but I'm trying not to think about it.."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook02Page001Ans0005.Text: [Flirt] "It is wonderful to be able to see you again. Did you choose how your human form looks or are you just naturally beautiful in all your forms?"
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook02Page001Cue0005.Text:
"I don't know about this form being beautiful, but this is just how the magic I use makes me look. Honestly, when I started using it, I still had trouble telling warmbloods apart. I was used to looking at scale patterns and horns, not wrinkles and ears. I can still get thrown off when someone I know changes their hairstyle."
"Although, I have come to appreciate how attractive some warmbloods are like y..." {n}Terendelev's eyes widen as her face goes completely red. She quickly raises one of her arms to awkwardly cover half her face before responding with a bit of a mumble to her voice from the arm covering her mouth.{/n} "I don't think I'll ever get used to the concept of blushing however."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook02Page001Ans0006.Text: "The scale held a story of when you were corrupted. You dreamt of your old home. Could we be near your home?"
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook02Page002Cue0001.Text:
"I was corrupted?" {n}She looks at the surroundings confused.{/n} "I feel like that is something that I would remember. Perhaps you are confusing me with someone else? Many dragons have fought for Crusades over the years in various capacities. Perhaps you are thinking of one of them?"
{n}She clears her throat as if to signify the changing of subjects.{/n} "As for this being my old home, I can't say. It has been so long, and my memories of it have gotten dull, but even if they were sharp I can't find any landmarks in any direction. Perhaps discussing more recent events may prove more fruitful than discussing my old home. There could be a clue in something that recently happened. The last thing I recall is my fight with Deskari, though I don't remember how it ended."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook02Page002Ans0002.Text: "I witnessed your fight, Deskari killed you."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook02Page002Cue0002.Text:
"No, that... can't be right. I certainly don't believe myself stronger than a Demon Lord, but the natural order would be for me to return to the River of Souls to be judged in the Boneyard. Then I would move on to become a petitioner in an afterlife, hopefully Heaven. That black void we met in doesn't fit the descriptions of any of those places."
{n}She closes her eyes tight and grips her head with a hand. From the corner of your eyes, you notice an unnatural black fog rolling in. Before you can react, you turn to Terenedelev as she begins to speak.{/n} "I suppose it could have been the Void, but I don't understand how I could have survived any amount of time there." {n}When you turn back to where the fog was, nothing is there.{/n}
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook02Page002Ans0003.Text: "Have you seen any black fog here?"
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook02Page002Cue0003.Text: {n}Terendelev tilts her head.{/n} "Black fog? I can't say that I have. Nor do I recall hearing about that occurring in the Worldwound either, but the weather phenomena of the Worldwound are poorly documented."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook02Page002Ans0004.Text: [Flirt] "So do you remember me trying to get a lovely dragon as my date to the festivities?"
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook02Page002Cue0004.Text: "Yes, I remember how quickly you attempted to start a courtship with me. I want to say that you haven't done the proper customs for seeking the affection of a silver dragon, but I imagine a century of preparation might be a bit much for most warmbloods." {n}Terendelev chuckles with a grin.{/n}
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook02Page002Ans0005.Text: [Tell her about the campaign to retake Drezen, and leave no detail out]
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook02Page002Cue0005.Text: {n}Terendelev stares at you throughout your story, nodding at points, and shaking her head at others.She waits for you to finish before speaking up about your choices.{/n}
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook02Page002Cue0006.Text: "I'm glad you were able to assist those people sheltering at that tavern."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook02Page002Cue0007.Text: "I was unaware that the Wardstones had angels within. While I am sad the wardstone no longer stands, I'm glad you could restore the proper order."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook02Page002Cue0008.Text: "I wasn't there, so perhaps there was no other choice, but I wish you hadn't weakened the defenses against the Worldwound by destroying the Wardstone."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook02Page002Cue0009.Text: "I was unaware that the Wardstones had angels within. I am glad that you were able to help them."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook02Page002Cue0000.Text: "I was unaware that the Wardstones had angels within. I feel there must have been a better choice than killing those angels..."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook02Page002Cue0011.Text: "I can't believe you used demons in your assault on Drezen. As a leader, it is your duty to protect those under you, not throw them to indiscriminate monsters."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook02Page002Cue0012.Text: "Your transformation during the siege however is unusual. I've never heard of a warmblood or even a dragon taking on traits of an Aeon. It is... truly incredible. I'm honestly a little jealous."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook02Page002Cue0013.Text: "Your transformation during the siege however is unusual. I've never heard of a warmblood or even a dragon taking on traits of an Angel to this degree. You are truly blessed."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook02Page002Cue0014.Text: "Your transformation during the siege however is unusual. I've never heard of a warmblood or even a dragon taking on traits of an Azata to this degree. I've heard that havoc dragons are fierce defenders of freedom, so I'm sure she'll be a fine ally. Although, you should probably try and keep her chaos in check."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook02Page002Cue0015.Text: "The power that you gained during the siege however is unusual. I've never heard of anything like it. I don't feel like relying on chaos is the best choice though. Order is necessary for fighting demons."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook02Page002Cue0016.Text: "Your transformation during the siege however is unusual. I've never heard of a warmblood or even a dragon taking on traits of a Demon to this degree. You need to find a way to separate yourself from this dark power before it consumes you."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook02Page002Cue0017.Text: "Your transformation during the siege however is unusual. I've never heard of a warmblood or even a dragon taking on traits of the undead without the assistance of magic. You need to find a way to separate yourself from this dark power before it consumes you."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook02Page002Ans0018.Text: [Tell her about the campaign to retake Drezen, and leave any potentially objectionable details out]
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook02Page002Cue0018.Text: {n}Terenedelv stares at you throughout your story. Her stare gets more intense everytime you avoid specifics of your journey. When you have finished your tale, she lets out an exasperated breath.{/n} "I can tell you left out some details, and I can guess why. I realize war, especially against demons, is hard and hard choices must be made, but we must never lose sight of either honor or mercy. I won't press the point though, and I hope your reluctance is because you recognize the need to do better."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook02Page002Cue0019.Text: "It sounds like a lot has happened since my fight with Deskari. It doesn't sound like he's been sighted since our fight though. So I guess we can't track where I ended up based on his movements." {n}She runs her hand over her face.{/n} "Okay, maybe I am looking at this wrong. Maybe the answer is at the other end. Do you know where I fought Deskari? I know it was a city, but I can't remember where."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook02Page002Cue0010.Text: "Should I remember it? All I can really remember is that the fight was in a city."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook02Page002Cue0021.Text: "No, I know that wasn't it. I've never been to Drezen. The Second Crusade was over before I joined with the Crusaders."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook02EndCue0001.Text:
"Kenabres? I guess that would make sense as you said that was where you began your march on Drezen for the Fifth Crusade. Wait, Kenabres?" {n}She begins to repeat the name over and over while her eyes dart back and forth. Before long her face lights up in excitement.{/n} "Kenabres! I remember now! I swore to protect it, an oath that I now renew!"
{n}Terendelev falls to her knees and performs some small ritual movements with her hands before standing up once more with a broad smile on her face.{/n} "The memories are flooding back! I can see the smiling faces of all the people in Kenabres. There are so many people that I need to protect."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook02EndCue0002.Text: {n}She embraces you in a hug.{/n} "Thank you so much. I don't think I'd have managed to recover these precious memories without your help." {n}She reluctantly releases you from the hug.{/n}
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook02EndCue0003.Text:
"Thanks for visiting me again. I think we made some real progress tonight. Maybe there are some clues in my memories. Hopefully I'll have some ideas of how we can proceed when you visit again. Until then, take care."
{n}You open your eyes and find yourself back where you started holding the silver scale.{/n}
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook03Page001Cue0002.Text: "I don't really know. I was pondering my memories of Kenabres when suddenly there was a flash of light. At first, I thought it was you arriving, but then I looked around and I was surrounded by familiar buildings and I was home."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook03Page001Cue0003.Text: "I don't know. I've flown all over the city, and I haven't seen anyone. Everyone must have been taken before I arrived, but I haven't been able to find any clues."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook03Page001Cue0004.Text: {n}She gives you a weak smile.{/n} "Yeah. I found myself able to return to it when I arrived, but that is a small comfort when my home is in danger."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook03Page001Ans0005.Text: "I haven't heard of anything unusual happening in Kenabres."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook03Page002Cue0001.Text:
"You... haven't? But I've been here for weeks." {n}Terendelev scrunches her face up and hunches over as words start pouring out of her mouth.{/n} "Wait has it been weeks? No, that can't be right. I haven't seen that many sunrises. Wait, have I seen any sunrises? I don't... when did I last see the sun?"
{n}Terendelev's eyes widen as she jolts up and faces you.{/n} "I think you need to leave. Now!" {n}As she speaks, you notice black fog slowly creeping into sight in the streets behind her."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook03Page002Cue0002.Text: "This place isn't reality. I've been here for days or weeks or months, and the stars and moon haven't moved. I don't know where we are, but combined with my constant confusion, I'm worried that I'm not actually Terendelev." {n}She casts her eyes down to the ground.{/n} "I only took that name after you mentioned it. Before I thought I was just a dream of the darkness you found me in. If I was born of that darkness, there is no telling what my true purpose is."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook03Page002Cue0003.Text: "I don't know, but I am missing so many. And the only ones we can confirm are from when you met Terendelev, which amount to barely a few minutes."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook03Page002Cue0004.Text: {n}Terendelev hesitantly turns around to see what you are talking about.{/n} "That feels like the darkness you found me in. Could it be here to drag me back to that dark place?"
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook03Page002Ans0005.Text: "I don't believe you are evil. Let's talk through your memories. Maybe there is a clue there."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook03Page003Cue0001.Text: "If you still trust me, then I am willing to try trusting myself."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook03Page003Cue0002.Text: "I think you are making a mistake, but maybe you'll come to understand if I humor you."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook03Page003Cue0003.Text: {n}The black fog seems to cease its slow approach at her words.{/n} "I'm not sure what memories to talk about though." {n}She closes her eyes in thought while silently mouthing her thoughts for a few moments before opening her eyes once again.{/n} "I knew many people involved in the Crusade. If they survived the attack on Kenabres, then you've likely met them. So I'll tell you my memories about them, and you can tell me what you know about them."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook03Page003Cue0004.Text: "The people that immediately come to mind are Queen Galfrey, Hulrun, Ramien, and Staunton."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook03Page003Cue0005.Text: "The people that immediately come to mind are Queen Galfrey, Hulrun, and Ramien."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook03Page003Ans0006.Text: "Tell me your memories of Queen Galfrey."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook03Page003Cue0006.Text: "We've spoken at length during her visits to Kenabres. She's an inspiring leader. She has some self doubts after nearly a century, but she seems to carry them well."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook03Page003Ans0007.Text: "I wish I could make Galfrey happy, but she believes it is her duty to be miserable."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook03Page003Cue0007.Text: "Does that mean you wish to date both a dragon and a queen? Well I can't blame you, she is beautiful..." {n}Terendelev's face gradually reddens as she realizes what she said.{/n} "Please don't tell her I said that."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook03Page003Cue0008.Text: "I'm not surprised. I hope someday she can be released from her duty so she can find happiness."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook03Page003Cue0009.Text: "I'm glad to hear that she hasn't changed. She's under such pressure that it is a miracle that she hasn't broken yet."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook03Page003Ans0000.Text: "Galfrey banished me to the Abyss for being too successful."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook03Page003Cue0000.Text: {n}Terendelev frowns at your answer.{/n} "Really? That doesn't sound like the Queen Galfrey that I knew, but I don't know what has happened to her since my death. Perhaps she is making poor decisions due to other events, or at least communicating her decisions poorly. I hope that you might be able to reconcile with her in the future as the only ones that benefit when crusaders fight each other are the demons."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook03Page003Cue0011.Text: "Hulrun was a proud Crusader that served as both prelate and governor to Kenabres. I spoke often with him to determine the best places to defend the city especially during events like the festival. We weren't particularly close, but I remember writing letters about him to the Royal Council. The letters said, well I don't actually remember what they said, but I remember crying while writing them? I guess I must have been moved to tears by his bravery and dedication?"
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook03Page003Cue0012.Text: "So I guess our memories of him are the same then."

RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook03Page003Cue0015.Text: "You are right, he wasn't the sort of person to have any kind of serious issues."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook03Page003Ans0016.Text: "Was Ramien talking to you about his acolytes sneaking into the wardstone?"

RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook03Page003Cue0018.Text: "Oh Staunton, why didn't you ever tell me. Unless, is that what I was talking with him about?"

RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook03Page003Cue0019.Text: {n}A small tear rolls down her cheek.{/n} "I'm sad to hear my friend died, but I'm sure he is happy to have died a hero."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook03Page003Ans0010.Text: "I changed the timeline. Staunton has been serving proudly as the Commander of an unconquerable Drezen for the last 70 years."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook03Page003Ans0021.Text: "When I spoke of you to Halaseliax, he asked me to remind you that despite your self-doubts, he would always be proud of you."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook03Page003Cue0021.Text: "Oh, I'm glad to hear that he is doing well. But I'm not sure what self-doubts he is talking about. Am I forgetting about something important?"
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook03Page003Ans0022.Text: "So have you noticed anything in our discussions?"
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook03Page003Ans0024.Text: "I don't think this is working. I'll go ahead and leave. I'm sorry it ended this way."

{n}As she takes a moment to compose herself, the black fog ceases its advance, and begins to thin.{/n}

{n}She lets out a deep breath as the dark fog completely vanishes behind her.{/n} "I'm going to need to spend some time thinking about this, but thank you for not giving up on me."

RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook03Page004Cue0003.Text: {n}Terendelev awkwardly shifts her feet while looking down.{/n} "Umm, listen before you leave, I feel like there is something that we need to talk about, and I don't want to drag it out anymore. RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook03Page004Cue0005.Text: "Well, we'll need to perform a ritual to officially signify the start of the courtship. RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook03Page004Cue0006.Text: {n}Terendelev averts her eyes from you.{/n} "Also, I want to wait until you have managed to purge yourself of that evil influence before we officially begin the courtship. I don't think I could watch you destroy your soul further."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook03Page004Ans0007.Text: "So you want us to have a silver dragon style relationship?"
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook03Page004Cue0007.Text: "No. I know that would be as difficult for you as a warmblood style relationship would be for me. RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook03Page004Ans0008.Text: "Anything else I should know about silver dragon courtship?"
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook03Page004Cue0008.Text:
"Do you like singing? Because it is an important tradition for every apology to be delivered as a ballad." {n}A few moments pass before Terendelev chuckles.{/n} "I'm kidding.  "As an example, many elder silver dragons will choose to limit the frequency of their interactions with their mates as a sign of their devotion to their mates. It is considered the height of romance among silver dragons. I recognize that that isn't something that makes sense to warmbloods or even other dragons, so that isn't an oath that I would ever ask of you."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook03Page004Ans0009.Text: "Why are rituals and oaths so important?"
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook03Page004Cue0009.Text: "How do I put this? I guess in silver dragon culture, a romantic partner upholding an oath to you is seen as the same kind of intimacy as warmbloods view snuggling? The rituals that accompany the oath are a means of showing your seriousness."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook03Page004Ans0000.Text: "I'm in a relationship with someone else, is that a problem for you?"
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook03Page004Cue0000.Text: "Not particularly. While there are rituals associated with monogamy, there are plenty of others that aren't. And if I get along with this person, there are some rituals and oaths that require three or more people."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook03Page004Cue0011.Text: "Then I don't think a relationship between us will work out as they are very important to me."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook03Page004Ans0012.Text: "I still want to pursue a relationship with you."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook03Page004Ans0013.Text: "I don't think that is a good fit for me."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook03Page004Ans0014.Text: "I don't want to pursue a relationship."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook03EndCue0001.Text: {n}The black fog begins approaching again.{/n} "It would seem so. Perhaps I am a figment of your imagination? RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook03EndCue0002.Text: {n}Terendelev sniffles while giving you a weak smile.{/n} "I'm sorry too. I wish I hadn't been... whatever it is that I am. But if you are safe, that is all that matters."

RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook04Page001Cue0002.Text: "I was hoping you might have some insight into that. I was just wandering around the empty town when all of a sudden I remembered the sensation of my death. And then my surroundings changed to resemble that day. RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook04Page001Cue0003.Text: "Well I guess that explains why it suddenly appeared. You released the essence bound to it, and that essence ended up here."

RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook04Page002Cue0001.Text: "I think there is only one thing I can do. I need to merge with it. RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook04Page002Cue0003.Text: "No. my soul being split like this is unnatural. It is necessary for me to be reunited for the sake of order."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook04Page002Ans0004.Text: "Proper order would be that you were never broken like this."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook04Page002Cue0004.Text: {n}Terendelev gives you a weak smile.{/n} "You are right. That is how the universe should be. I hope that you can find a way to make it happen."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook04Page002Cue0005.Text: "I admit that I was looking forward to a courtship with you. But I am sure that if we are meant to be together, the universe will find a way to bring us together..."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook04Page002Cue0006.Text: "...I don't think it would have worked out between us."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook04Page002Cue0007.Text: "...I don't know. I have developed feelings for you. I don't believe those feelings will go away, but I don't know how I'll react to them once I'm whole."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook04Page002Ans0008.Text: "Could you swear an oath to me that you'll return?"
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook04Page002Cue0008.Text: "Asking an oath of a silver dragon is not a simple request. An oath sworn by a silver dragon has both weight and import."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook04Page002Cue0009.Text: "I'm afraid I can not bring myself to make that oath to you."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook04Page002Cue0000.Text: {n}She holds her hand to her heart in silence.{/n} "I think I would be willing to make that oath to you if you ask."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook04Page002Cue0011.Text: "You are my friend, so I would be willing to make that oath if you ask."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook04Page002Ans0012.Text: "Thank you for the opportunity to say goodbye."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook04Page002Ans0013.Text: "I ask for an oath that you will return."

RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereChpt05Dial001Cue0001.Text: "I can see that you haven't given up on having a date with me, but I'm afraid I must still refuse."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereChpt05Dial001Cue0002.Text: "While I am flattered, I'm afraid that I haven't known you long enough to share the sentiment. And I have a job I must do now."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereChpt05Dial002Ans0001.Text: [Hand Terendelev her scale] "This scale is from when Deskari slays you in the near future. I am an Aeon that has come back to correct the natural flow by preventing your soul from being shattered."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereChpt05Dial002Cue0001.Text: {n}Terendelev looks into your eyes.{/n} "I feel the currents of energy that swirl around you. Your breath is as cold as the starlit deserts that lie in the great beyond. But that doesn't make you an Aeon in and of itself."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereChpt05Dial002Cue0002.Text: {n}Terendelev stares at the scale in her hand, narrowing her eyes as she looks at it.{/n} "I can see that this scale is more than a mere trinket to you. RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereChpt05Dial003Ans0001.Text: "Do you remember anything from the previous timeline?"
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereChpt05Dial003Cue0001.Text: "I don't know how I could. From what you told me, I died in the fight with Deskari, so the only memories that I could have would be my death, which I do not remember."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereChpt05Dial003Cue0002.Text: "I have occasionally seen flashes of the two of us talking about... something, but that must just be my mind wandering while I've been recovering."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook04bPage001Cue0001.Text: {n}Focusing your energy into the scale again, you feel your surroundings shifting once more. As you open your eyes, you find yourself in a building. Looking around, it appears to be someone's home. The front door opens and you see Terendelev's human form enter the building as she waves at you.{/n} "I was wondering when I would see you next. Relax while you have the chance."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook04bPage001Cue0002.Text: "We're still in Kenabres. Or at least the abandoned version you've previously visited. I've been using this house as my base for a while. I still feel uncomfortable using someone else's house, but I know this is just a replica."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook04bPage001Cue0003.Text: "Alright? Dragons are much more suited for solitude than warmbloods, but I still wish I could get out of here and return to helping the people of Kenabres."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook04bPage001Ans0004.Text: "Any progress in figuring out how to escape?"
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook04bPage001Cue0004.Text: "...no. I feel like the answer is within reach, but I just can't seem to grasp it. I'm starting to think that I'm going to be stuck here forever."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook04bPage001Ans0006.Text: "So what do you plan to do now if you can't leave?"
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook04bPage002Cue0001.Text: {n}Terendelev winces.{/n} "I don't know. While we can spend time together here, I'm not sure what kind of relationship we can really have here. RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook04bPage002Ans0002.Text: "I'm sorry, but I don't think this will work."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook04bEndCue0001.Text: "I'll continue to persist as long as I can. I don't know how long that will be since I don't even fully understand how I ended up here. RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook04bEndCue0002.Text: "I'm sorry, but I can feel that you've chosen to completely surrender yourself to darkness.
