RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook05Page001Cue0001.Text: {n}Anevia informs you that Terendelev will be waiting by the city gates at night for you. You set out at the appropriate time. As you approach the gate, you see Terendelev leaning her back against the gate while staring at the starry sky. She turns to you as she hears your approaching footsteps. She smiles at you and pats on the wall next to her telling you to join her.{/n}
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook05Page001Cue0002.Text: "Thank you for meeting me here. I love looking at the stars, they remind me of how ordered the universe is. You know this is technically the fourth time we've met, yet I feel like I've known you for so much longer." {n}As you join her leaning against the gate, she holds out her hand. She opens her palm revealing a familiar sparkling scale.{/n} "And I think I have this to thank for that feeling."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook05Page001Cue0003.Text: "I found it on the ground when we parted ways. I recognized it as my own scale immediately. I picked it up to investigate. This might sound weird, but I feel like it wanted me to find it?"
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook05Page001Cue0004.Text: "I normally wouldn't get sentimental over a shed scale, but it helped save me from a horrible fate. And this might sound weird, but I felt like it wanted me to hold onto it?"
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook05Page001Ans0005.Text: "So why do you have the scale to thank for feeling like you know me?"
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook05Page001Cue0005.Text: "Well after finding the scale, I started having visions of the two of us talking." {n}She holds the scale up to her chest.{/n} "At first I couldn't make sense of them, but I think I understand now. These are memories from the timeline where I died, and the time we spent together."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook05Page001Cue0006.Text: "After you gave me the scale, I started having visions of the two of us talking." {n}She holds the scale up to her chest.{/n} "At first they were vague. But then we met in Kenabres again, and they started to make more sense. These are memories from the timeline where I died, and the time we spent together."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook05Page001Ans0007.Text: "So you remember the previous timeline now?"
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook05Page001Cue0007.Text: "In part? I don't have any memories from the ravener made from me, so I think I only gained my memories of our interactions through the scale."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook05Page001Ans0008.Text: "What do these memories mean to you?"
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook05Page001Cue0008.Text: "Having memories of a timeline that didn't happen anymore is certainly a different experience, but in a sense they did happen since you remember them too. And I couldn't be happier to share those memories with you."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook05Page001Cue0009.Text: "Besides, I told you before that if we were meant to be together, the universe would find a way to bring us together even if you found a way to save me from that fate." {n}Terendelev grabs your hand.{/n} "I'd say that this is proof that at least the universe thinks we are supposed to be together."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook05Page001Ans0000.Text: "Do you want to continue our relationship?"
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook05Page001Ans0011.Text: "Was there anything else you wanted to talk about?"
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook05Page001Cue0012.Text: "I'm back. It took me a little bit of time to sort out my feelings, but I made an oath and I was not going to break my word to you." {n}She looks down to her feet.{/n} "I don't think I'm ready to return to the battlefield, but I think seeing you will help me make progress."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook05Page001Cue0013.Text: "Terrible? A lot of my soul was corrupted by those dark magics. Without you saving the part that you did, I don't think any of me would have survived untouched by that darkness."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook05Page001Ans0014.Text: "Why can't you return to the battlefield?"
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook05Page001Cue0014.Text: "I still have the memories from the ravener. I remember crushing crusaders with my bare hands, and I think I'd just get flashbacks to that if I stepped onto a battlefield right now. Hopefully, I can work through this, but for now I'm going to be staying on the backline and helping in other ways."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook05Page001Ans0015.Text: "Do you wish you hadn't made that oath?"
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook05Page001Cue0015.Text: "No, I'm glad that you did. It gave me something to focus on while my soul was healing. Without that, I don't know if I would have been able to recover to this extent. Plus, it always feels nice to be able to fulfill an oath."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook05Page001Ans0016.Text: "Is there anything I can do to help you?"
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook05Page002Cue0001.Text: {n}Terendelev smiles at you.{/n} "Well that was actually what I came here for. We spoke about entering a courtship if I could ever find my way back to reality. I would like to do a ritual with you to formalize our relationship."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook05Page002Cue0002.Text:
{n}Terendelev moves in front of you with a grin on her face.{/n} "As I recall, we never actually formalized that relationship, and I am not that kind of silver dragon. But that is actually why I wanted to talk to you. I was hoping that we could perform a ritual to formalize our relationship."
{n}As she stares at you, you notice her cheeks gradually reddening.{/n} "I previously told you that I could feel the universe flowing through you, but you've changed since then and to be so close to the beauty of the stars is just breathtaking..."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook05Page002Ans0003.Text: "What ritual did you want to do?"
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook05Page002Cue0003.Text: "I think I might have mentioned this to you once before."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook05Page002Cue0004.Text: "The ritual involves us swearing our love to each other beneath the starry sky, and we compare the certainty of our love to the movement of the celestial bodies.
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook05Page002Cue0005.Text: "Its primary purpose is to declare a strong intent to courtship between the couple. The ritual is rarely used as a prerequisite for it is that the love between the participants must overcome an overwhelming trial to signify that their love has the blessing of the universe itself."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook05Page002Cue0006.Text: "I feel confident that we have met that requirement considering that we have managed to overcome the corruption of demons and death itself."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook05Page002Cue0007.Text: "Considering that we overcame time itself to come together, I think we've more than met that requirement."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook05Page002Ans0008.Text: "Are you sure you want to pursue a relationship based on memories from another timeline?"
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook05Page002Cue0008.Text: "Yes. I remember our time together just as clearly as anything else that has ever happened to me. And they still stir the same feelings that they stirred in the me that you knew. This might not be a normal situation, but I still care for you deeply and I wish to pursue a courtship with you."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook05Page002Ans0009.Text: "Are you sure this is something you want to do?"
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook05Page002Cue0009.Text: "This isn't something that I do lightly. I had a lot of time to think while I was within that scale. I care for you deeply, and I want to take this step with you."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook05Page003Cue0001.Text: "Alright, follow me then." {n}Terendelev walks a little bit away from the gate and transforms into her dragon form. You get a little bit of distance from the gate before taking on the form of your dragon soul. The two of you leap into the air and spend a few minutes flying together in the night sky. Soon, she touches down in a clearing away from any light sources. Following suit, you touch down and both of you return to your warmblood forms.{/n}
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook05Page003Cue0002.Text: "Alright, we need to go a little further out." {n}Terendelev walks a little bit away from the gate and transforms into her dragon form.{/n} "You can ride on my back, just please don't mention that I did this to anyone. While I don't mind doing it for you, it is kind of embarrassing." {n}Terendelev lowers her head and gives you a little help getting onto her back. Once you are secure, she leaps into the air and spends a few minutes flying in the night sky. Soon, she touches down in a clearing away from any light sources. She helps you down before transforming into her human form.{/n}
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook05Page003Cue0003.Text: "I think the stars should be bright enough here. I'll handle all of the formalities, all you need to do is speak your heart when I motion towards you." {n}Terendelev clears her throat and begins to speak in draconic while motioning towards the sky. After a couple of minutes of this, she moves both of her hands over her heart and begins to speak in common.{/n} "As sure as the movement of the stars in the sky, my heart beats in tune with {name}'s heart. I swear unto the stars that I shall endeavor to bring happiness to {name} as long as we are together." {n}Terendelev moves her hands from her heart pointing them at you.{/n}
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook05Page003Cue0005.Text: {n}Terendelev motions to you indicating that you are supposed to speak.{/n}
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook05Page004Cue0001.Text: {n}You can make out Terendelev shaking her head in the darkness.{/n}
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook05Page004Cue0002.Text: {n}Terendelev resumes speaking in Draconic. As she seems to be finishing up, she turns to face you once more and opens her arms to you.{/n}
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook05Page004Cue0003.Text: {n}Terendelev resumes speaking in Draconic. As she seems to be finishing up, she looks up and opens her arms up to the sky.{/n}
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook05Page004Cue0004.Text: {n}A few moments of silence pass before Terendelev speaks once more.{/n} "And with that, the ritual is complete, and our courtship has officially started."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook05Page004Cue0005.Text: "Well you missed your cue, but otherwise I think it went well."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook05Page004Cue0006.Text: "Perfect, thank you for indulging me. I realize that it probably didn't make much sense to you."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook05Page004Cue0007.Text: "I promise that in the future, I'll try and prepare you better for any rituals that I want us to do, but... I just didn't want to wait on this one."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook05Page004Ans0008.Text: "Can you explain what you just did?"
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook05Page004Cue0008.Text: "There is a lot of nuance, but I can try and give the broad strokes without the explanation dragging on till tomorrow's sunset. I started by calling out to all the stars that are in the sky, the exact words vary depending on what stars are visible. Afterwards, we were to declare our feelings in the starlight, so that the oaths may be remembered by the stars themselves. Finally, I had to choose the most beautiful visible star to be the guardian of our oaths."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook05Page004Cue0009.Text: "I may have improvised during the final step and chosen one of the stars visible in your form because they outshine any other star that I have ever seen." {n}You see Terendelev's hands rushing to her face.{/n} "I'm really glad that it is dark right now, otherwise you could see how hard I'm blushing right now." {n}A few moments pass.{/n} "Please forget I said that."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook05Page004Cue0000.Text: "Well we are courting each other now, so that means we can be romantic with each other to heart's desires. I actually prepared some food before meeting up with you. Have you ever had ice cream? It isn't the easiest thing to make or store without magic, but being a dragon with a freezing breath has some benefits. After we finish trying some, well the rest of the evening is up to you." {n}You can make out a grin on Terendelev's face in the starlight.{/n}
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook05EndCue0001.Text:
"Pretty much. I just wanted to let you know that I remembered our friendship. I imagine there aren't many that you can talk to about your memories from undone timelines. So feel free to talk with me about it if you ever have any concerns. You helped me when I was in trouble, so it is the least I can do for you." {n}Terendelev looks back to the sky.{/n} "Although for now, we can just watch the stars and enjoy the perfectly ordered complexities of the universe..."
{n}The two of you enjoy stargazing together for a while.{/n}
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook05EndCue0002.Text:
"Just keep being my friend. Spending time with you helps me sort through my feelings and just take my mind off of the worst of it." {n}Terendelev looks back to the sky.{/n} "Although for now, we can just watch the stars and enjoy the perfectly ordered complexities of the universe..."
{n}The two of you enjoy stargazing together for a while.{/n}
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook05EndCue0003.Text: {n}Terendelev transforms into her draconic form. You soon follow. Before taking off, Terendelev coils her neck around yours and nuzzles with you a little bit. The two of you soon return to Drezen where you enjoy her homemade ice cream and the rest of the evening together.{/n}
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBook05EndCue0004.Text: {n}Terendelev transforms into her draconic form and gives you another ride. The two of you soon return to Drezen where you enjoy her homemade ice cream and the rest of the evening together.{/n}
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereGenPage001Cue0001.Text: {n}As you focus on the scale, your surroundings fade away and you find yourself in the house that Terendelev is using as her base. It doesn't take long before Terendelev shows herself.{/n} "I'm glad you've come to visit again. It can get so boring here by myself."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereGenPage001Cue0002.Text: {n}As you focus on the scale, your surroundings fade away and you find yourself in the abandoned Kenabres once more. The sky is still lit by the stars and moon. It doesn't take long before Terendelev shows herself.{/n} "I'm glad you've come to visit again. Sadly, I haven't made any progress in figuring out a way out of here."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereGenPage001Cue0003.Text: {n}As you focus on the scale, your surroundings fade away and you find yourself in the field once more. The sky is still lit by the stars and moon. It doesn't take long before Terendelev shows herself.{/n} "I'm glad you've come to visit again. Sadly, I haven't made any progress in figuring out a way out of here."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereGenPage001Cue0004.Text: {n}As you focus on the scale, your surroundings fade away and you find yourself in the endless darkness once more. You channel your mythic power to push back the darkness. It takes only a few moments before a familiar voice can be heard.{/n} "You've returned my light, I wish I could have cleaned up a little for you, but I can't even see what needs to be cleaned." {n}She lightly chuckles.{/n}
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereGenPage001Ans0005.Text: "What do you think of my power?"
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereGenPage001Cue0005.Text: "You mean that light that surrounds you? It is truly a beautiful sight. It is as if heaven itself has descended. But I can sense a darkness hidden within it. Not just any darkness, but one that seeks to destroy the very balance of existence."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereGenPage001Cue0006.Text: "I can also sense some chaos mixed in?"
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereGenPage001Cue0007.Text: "There's another darkness, one that is even greater than the impenetrable veil surrounding me."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereGenPage001Cue0008.Text: "And I can see the beauty of the stars within your eyes."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereGenPage001Cue0009.Text: "I don't understand how you have such different powers combined. I don't think this combination will last. Choose carefully when the time comes, and remember the importance of order in the universe."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereGenPage001Cue0000.Text: "Order is for the sake of protecting others, not self gain, but I suppose it is too late to convince you that this path is wrong."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereGenPage001Cue0011.Text: {n}She stares at you for a few moments before turning away with a slight blush.{/n} "Umm, it is beautiful. Such order is what silver dragons aspire to. To have achieved it in such a short lifetime is a miracle."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereGenPage001Cue0012.Text: "You've transformed yourself into a dragon in full? I didn't know that was possible. I feel honored that you would choose to join us."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereGenPage001Cue0013.Text: "I never had the opportunity to meet any angels, but I am sure the ones that served in the First Crusade would have been proud to call you their {mf|brother|sister}-in-arms."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereGenPage001Cue0014.Text: "I can't say that I am a big fan of your power. I know your heart is in the right place, but the process is important as well."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereGenPage001Cue0015.Text: "I can't say that I am a big fan of your power. Breaking laws, whether mortal or natural, is not something to be celebrated. I hope that at the very least you are using these powers to help people."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereGenPage001Cue0016.Text: "...You've lost yourself to the darkness within your soul. I hope you'll be able to find yourself once more in the future."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereGenPage001Cue0017.Text: "My best guess is that I remember most of my memories. My memories tinged with darker emotions seem to be the ones that are missing. They might have been absorbed by that darkness you found me in."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereGenPage001Cue0018.Text: "I remember Kenabres. I'm still struggling with the idea that I was able to forget someplace so important to me. I haven't found anything that might help in my memories yet."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereGenPage001Cue0019.Text: "Unfortunately, I haven't remembered anything new yet. All I remember is my name, meeting you, and fighting Deskari. After that I ended up in this darkness somehow."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereGenPage001Ans0010.Text: "Can you tell me about silver dragons?"
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereGenPage001Cue0010.Text:
{n}Terendelev smiles.{/n} "I am tempted to say that we are the noblest of all dragons, but that would make me sound conceited. Some call us the bravest of the dragons, but I make no such claim myself. All I can say is that we seek to help others, and that we take great interest in the affairs of the world."
"We honor our oaths, and respect the rules. We follow a code of honor. The older a silver dragon becomes, the more it adheres to these customs and rituals. Even our brethren, the other metallic dragons, often fail to understand our way of life. Many believe that the rules we follow are outdated and obsolete. But our elders live such pure, beautiful lives... It is a shame that the other dragons do not see the value of such a lifestyle. I am still young and inexperienced, but I hope that by the time I am a thousand years old, I too have learned to live such an exemplary life."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereGenPage001Ans0021.Text: [Flirt] "Are there rituals necessary for courting a silver dragon?"
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereGenPage001Cue0021.Text:
{n}Terendelev grins.{/n} "Oh is there a silver dragon that you are wishing to court?" {n}Terendelev giggles.{/n} "There are certainly many rituals associated with courtship among silver dragons. Every young silver dragon swoons at the idea of a potential mate circling the mountain they lair in every week for a century as part of one of the more complex rituals."
"That isn't our only courtship ritual though. There are countless others, each with a slightly different meaning." {n}She stares up at the moon.{/n} "The one that I always found the most romantic involved a couple beneath a clear night sky declaring their love to be as certain as the movements of the stars and the moon."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereGenPage001Cue0023.Text: {n}Terendelev turns to you and winks.{/n} "I think I'd like to show you the full ritual someday if I can ever find my way back."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereGenPage001Ans0024.Text: "Do you know what that black fog was?"
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereGenPage001Cue0024.Text: "Not entirely. I assume it was a manifestation of that darkness you found me in, and that it was trying to pull me back when I was vulnerable. But I don't know what that darkness was, so that answer only raises more questions."
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBookLiPage001Cue0001.Text: {n}Your necromantic energies infuse the scale transporting your mind to visit the portion of Terendelev's soul bound within. As your senses adjust to your new surroundings, you find yourself within the basement of the Grey Garrison. Terendelev is curled up in a corner of a cell. She raises her head to look in your direction as she notices your presence. She immediately lowers her head refusing to look at you further upon confirming that it is you.{/n}
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBookLiPage001Cue0002.Text: {n}Terendelev stays completely still at your words. Were it not for her soul pretending to breathe, the room would be completely silent.{/n}
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBookLiPage001Ans0004.Text: "Do you plan to just ignore me forever?"
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBookLiEndCue0001.Text: {n}Terendelev continues to remain unmoving in the corner at your declaration. You feel nothing as her form vanishes from your vision and you return to where you were before.{/n}
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBookFailEndCue0001.Text: {n}You focus on the scale within your hand. The process seems hopeless however. You don't know what kind of power Storyteller was talking about, and nothing you try seems to activate the magic of the scale.{/n}
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBookFailEndCue0003.Text:
{n}You focus your energy into the scale and find yourself transported to the empty void once more. As you try to figure out how to find the voice you heard before, a maniacal laughter rings out replacing the endless silence.{/n}
{n}You blink as you find yourself back in reality. You look down to find that the scale has darkened and shattered. You briefly try and focus on the remnants before determining that the scale no longer works.{/n}
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBookFailEndCue0004.Text: {n}You focus on the scale once more trying to draw yourself to that otherworld. However, the scale refuses to cooperate. As you continue to focus on the scale, you feel it collapse to dust. Now without the medium you used, you can no longer speak with Terendelev.{/n}
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBookFailEndCue0005.Text: {n}You focus on the scale once more trying to draw yourself to that otherworld. However, nothing happens. It would seem that without your mythic power, you can no longer activate the scale's magic.{/n}
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBookFailEndCue0006.Text: {n}You focus on the scale once more trying to draw yourself to that otherworld. However, the scale refuses to cooperate. As you continue to focus your mythic power on the scale, you feel it collapse to dust. Now without the medium you used, you can no longer speak with Terendelev.{/n}
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBookFailEndCue0007.Text: {n}The scale lays dormant when you attempt to channel your power into it.{/n}
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBookFailEndCue0008.Text: {n}You can sense it may still hold some purpose though.{/n}
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereBookFailEndCue0009.Text: {n}Cracks begin to form in the scale as the power courses into it. Before you can stop the flow, the scale collapses into a pile of dust.{/n}
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereSlideAeonCue0001.Text: Terendelev set out into the world seeking her place in it. She stopped briefly in Kenabres before moving on to lands in more need of her assistance.
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereSlideAeonCue0002.Text: Terendelev returned to the city she called home for so many years. Despite her fond memories of a bustling city, she found few of her old friends in the small town. Those that she could find were complete strangers. As her disappointment grew, she moved on to find a place for herself in this new timeline.
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereSlideAeonCue0003.Text: Her greatest disappointment was the loss of her love, the Commander. While wandering the land, she kept an eye out for any clues that might help her find the Commander, but she only seemed to find dead ends.
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereSlideAeonCue0004.Text: Despite her lack of progress, she was convinced that she would someday find {mf|him|her} again. They had met in two timelines already, so she was sure they would find a way in this new timeline.
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereSlide0001Cue0001.Text:
With the Commander's ascension, Terendelev discovered that she had absorbed a portion of mythic power from her interactions with the Commander, and so she ascended to godhood alongside her love. She would create a new lair within the Commander's divine realm. When their duties allowed, they would get together for a romantic evening full of stargazing, oaths, and other activities.
Her church would promote protection and order. As her religion spread among dragons, many of them would seek to emulate her deeds by adopting a city of warmbloods to protect.
She is said to have crafted the original version of her holy symbol, a shield adorned with a field of stars, out of one of her scales that was particularly precious to her, and she is said to carry that original version with her everywhere she goes.
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereSlide0002Cue0001.Text: Terendelev would return to Kenabres to watch over the city. A festival was held to celebrate the end of the Fifth Crusade. While there was less need for a protector with the end of the threat of the Worldwound, she still loved the city and all of its people.
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereSlide0002Cue0002.Text: Another reason for staying in Kenabres was its proximity to the Worldwound and its easy passage to the divine realm of her love, the Commander. She would regularly make trips into the lands of the Sarkoris Scar to see her beloved.
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereSlide0002Cue0003.Text: During her visits, she would teach Targona about what it meant to be a silver dragon. In time, the three dragons would swear a new oath of love together as Targona and Terendelev developed feelings for each other that complimented their feelings for the Commander.
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereSlide0002Cue0004.Text: While she never converted to worshiping the Commander, Terendelev did make a point to help out the newly established church dedicated to the Commander in Kenabres and to give an occasional prayer to her friend that helped her so much while she was there.
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereSlide0002Cue0005.Text: Terendelev's duties in Kenabres meant that she couldn't always spend time with her love. However, she made it a point to carve out time to spend together whenever her love was in the area or when it had been too long since she last fulfilled her oath to regularly hug her love.
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereSlide0002Cue0006.Text: While spending time with the Commander, she would find opportunities to teach Targona about what it meant to be a silver dragon. In time, the three dragons would swear a new oath of love together as Targona and Terendelev developed feelings for each other that complimented their feelings for the Commander.
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereSlide0002Cue0007.Text: She mourned the loss of her love, the Commander. She would often leave the city at night to look at the night sky and remember the night they swore their love to each other.
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereSlide0002Cue0008.Text: Kenabres made the festival yearly in remembrance of the Commander and {mf|his|her} accomplishments. Terendelev made it a point to take part in the festival every year and share her memories of her friend to any who would listen.
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereSlide0002Cue0009.Text: Terendelev would often head to the Sarkoris Scar to visit Targona and check in on the new dragon. In time, the two of them began to develop feelings for each other and would swear their love for each other under the starlight.
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereSlide0003Cue0001.Text: Rumors abound that within the depths of the Commander's divine realm lies Terendelev's soul. It is unknown whether the soul is kept merely as some kind of prize or as some twisted showing of a corrupted idea of love, but many warriors of Iomedae have attempted to infiltrate the realm. Their corpses now stand guard with no one having confirmed that the soul is truly there.
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereSlide0003Cue0002.Text: Rumors abound that the Commander held a portion of Terendelev's soul. It is unknown whether the soul is kept merely as some kind of prize or as some twisted showing of a corrupted idea of love, but many warriors of Iomedae have attempted to infiltrate the Commander's territory to rescue her. Their corpses now stand guard with no one having found the scale that carries the soul.
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereSlide0003Cue0003.Text: The Commander's spell that bound Terendelev's soul to her scale persisted after the Commander's death. The scale would pass from hand to hand as a minor knick knack once owned by the terrible Commander. No one realized the true value of the scale as no one but the Commander could activate the magic. And so Terendelev continued to wait in absolute silence.
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereSlide0003Cue0004.Text: Another rumor states that a devil was born of the darkness in Terendelev's soul following the Fifth Crusade. This devil covered in corrupted dragon scales is said to be unusually active making deals with those preparing for the Sixth Crusade. All of these deals are for the purpose of seeing her singular desire for the Commander's fall fulfilled.
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereSlide0004Cue0001.Text: Following the end of the Fifth Crusade, a most unusual archon joined the ranks of Iomedae's heavenly host. This archon had draconic scales across its entire body and was missing half of its face. The archon's first act was to swear that she would be the one to end the tyranny of the Commander, and joined the forces slowly building for the inevitable Sixth Crusade.
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereSlide0005Cue0001.Text: The Commander brought Terendelev's scale to {mf|his|her} divine realm. While Terendelev was capable of manifesting within the realm, due to the nature of the realm, she refused to ever leave the scale that she was bound to.
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereSlide0005Cue0002.Text: The Commander brought Terendelev's scale to {mf|his|her} divine realm. With the assistance of the Commander's power, she was able to manifest within the realm. She was grateful to be able to interact with others again, but something always felt off to her as she was unaware of the ravener carrying the other half of her soul wandering the world.
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereSlide0005Cue0003.Text: While the situation was not one that she ever could have foreseen, she found that she was content with this outcome. She was able to be together with someone she loved, and found ways to add order to their small corner of the cosmos.
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereSlide0005Cue0004.Text: Even if that order was ephemeral as a sand castle before the tide of the chaos that was the Commander's power.
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereSlide0005Cue0005.Text: She was rarely seen within the realm. While it was the only location available to her outside of the scale, she found the chaotic nature of the realm to be uncomfortable.
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereSlide0005Cue0006.Text: She became a fixture within the realm. Since she was unable to leave, she found her role within the realm providing emotional support and advice to those who served the Commander within the realm.
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereSlide0005Cue0007.Text: The Commander was regularly seen carrying around a silver scale from Terendelev. Occasionally, the Commander could be seen staring at the scale for a few moments before breaking out in a big smile. No one was aware that {mf|he|she} was actually communicating with a fragment of the dragon's soul.
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereSlide0005Cue0008.Text: Or that the Commander was having romantic liaisons with Terendelev during those brief moments.
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereSlide0005Cue0009.Text: With the Commander's death, the scale holding a portion of Terendelev's soul lost the power anchoring Terendelev to it. Unmoored, the portion of Terendelev's soul was pulled back to the ravener that she had been rescued from. In time her soul was fully corrupted as she came to curse all mortals, the Commander most of all.
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereSlide0006Cue0001.Text: Following the end of the Fifth Crusade, rumors spread that an archon born of Terendelev's soul had joined the ranks of Iomedae's heavenly host. The archon never spoke of any possible connection, but the dragon scales on the archon's form fed the rumors.
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereSlide0006Cue0002.Text: Iomedae would regularly assign the archon to deliver messages or coordinate actions with the newly ascended Commander.
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereSlide0006Cue0003.Text: The archon didn't understand why, but she greatly enjoyed seeing the Commander. She would often drag their meetings on just to spend a few more moments with {mf|him|her}.
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereSlide0006Cue0004.Text: The archon would dedicate herself to stopping the spread of evil from the Commander's ascension.
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereSlide0006Cue0005.Text: The archon didn't know why she was so focused on this one particular evil, but she could feel in her soul that stopping the Commander was her duty.
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereSlide0007Cue0001.Text: With the Commander's ascension, Terendelev found that she had absorbed a portion of mythic power from the Commander. When given the option of ascending, she chose to reject it. She was still working through her issues from gaining the memories of the ravener made from her.
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereSlide0007Cue0002.Text: Terendelev would return to Kenabres to watch over the city. A festival was held to celebrate the end of the Fifth Crusade. While there was less need for a protector with the end of the threat of the Worldwound, she still loved the city and all of its people.
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereSlide0007Cue0003.Text: Terendelev would return to Kenabres to watch over the city. A festival was held to celebrate Terendelev's resurrection that was larger than the celebration for the end of the Fifth Crusade. While some believed that the city was no longer in need of a protector, Terendelev viewed the Commander's influence in the Sarkoris Scar to be just as dangerous to her charges' souls as the invading demon army had been to their bodies.
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereSlide0007Cue0004.Text: Learning that Queen Galfrey had been lost to the Commander's corruption hurt Terendelev's morale, but she persisted in her efforts to protect Kenabres even as Mendev passed more and more draconian laws to suppress the draconic protector.
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereSlide0007Cue0005.Text: Terendelev would return to Kenabres to watch over the city. A festival was held to celebrate Terendelev's resurrection that was larger than the celebration for the end of the Fifth Crusade. While there was less need for a protector with the end of the threat of the Worldwound, she found returning to her home to be helpful in recovering from her psychological wounds.
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereSlide0007Cue0006.Text: Another reason for staying in Kenabres was its proximity to the Worldwound and its easy passage to the divine realm of her love, the Commander. She would regularly make trips into the lands of the Sarkoris Scar to see her beloved.
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereSlide0007Cue0007.Text: During her visits, she would teach Targona about what it meant to be a silver dragon. In time, the three dragons would swear a new oath of love together as Targona and Terendelev developed feelings for each other that complimented their feelings for the Commander.
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereSlide0007Cue0008.Text: While she never converted to worshiping the Commander, Terendelev did make a point to help out the newly established church dedicated to the Commander in Kenabres and to give an occasional prayer to her friend that helped her so much while she was there.
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereSlide0007Cue0009.Text: Terendelev's duties in Kenabres meant that she couldn't always spend time with her love. However, she made it a point to carve out time to spend together whenever her love was in the area or when it had been too long since she last fulfilled her oath to regularly hug her love.
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereSlide0007Cue0000.Text: While spending time with the Commander, she would find opportunities to teach Targona about what it meant to be a silver dragon. In time, the three dragons would swear a new oath of love together as Targona and Terendelev developed feelings for each other that complimented their feelings for the Commander.
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereSlide0007Cue0011.Text: Terendelev mourned the loss of her love, the Commander. She would often leave the city at night to look at the night sky and remember the night they swore their love to each other.
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereSlide0007Cue0012.Text: Kenabres made the festival yearly in remembrance of the Commander and {mf|his|her} accomplishments. Terendelev made it a point to take part in the festival every year and share her memories of her friend to any who would listen.
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereSlide0007Cue0013.Text: Terendelev would often head to the Sarkoris Scar to visit Targona and check in on the new dragon. In time, the two of them began to develop feelings for each other and would swear their love for each other under the starlight.
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereQuestIntro.Text: Within an impenetrable darkness, a voice has cried out. Is this a friend or a foe luring in its prey. And what connection might this voice have to the slain dragon Terendelev?
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereQuestOutro.Text: Within the impenetrable darkness, the Commander found Terendelev and managed to reconnect with the fallen guardian.
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereQuestEntry0001L.Text: Perhaps your mythic power is sufficient to pierce through the darkness. Try using Terendelev's Scale.
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereQuestEntry0002L.Text: Check in with Terendelev to tell her of your victory in Drezen.
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereQuestEntry0003L.Text: Visit Terendelev by using the scale once more.
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereQuestEntry0004L.Text: You feel a pull from the scale towards Terendelev's remains. Perhaps you should investigate before moving on.
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereQuestEntry0005.Text: Check on Terendelev, Anevia might have an update.
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereQuestEntry0005L.Text: Terendelev may be visiting Drezen, check with Anevia for any news.
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereQuestEntry0006.Text: Use the scale to check on Terendelev.
RANROMANCE_LOCALIZATION.RanRomTereQuestEntry0006L.Text: The end of your campaign is approaching, perhaps you should speak with Terendelev once more while you can.
